profiles.purpose: Create or modify a bounded realization.
Change a shared boundary, schema or migration path.
Join components or responsibilities and close an integration obligation.
Create or repair tests, fixtures or evidence tooling.
Create or update an authoritative or review artifact.
Retire uncertainty through bounded investigation or prototype.
Create package/release artifacts and evidence without granting release authority.
Create or review the smallest coherent inspectable execution slices.
Separate a requested intervention from the desired outcome and establish a reviewed fit disposition.
